ui.teamBridge.schedule.edit_failed.value: Couldn't save your changes. They're still here. Try again.
ui.teamBridge.schedule.edit_failed.context_note: Desktop Team Bridge, editing an existing scheduled message. The server did not save the change (not a conflict). The person's edits stay in the dialog and they can submit again.

ui.teamBridge.schedule.edit_conflict.value: This message changed on another device.
ui.teamBridge.schedule.edit_conflict.context_note: Desktop Team Bridge, editing an existing scheduled message that the same person also changed on another device while this dialog was open. Headline of a warning notice; one or more detail sentences follow beneath it.

ui.teamBridge.schedule.edit_gone.value: This message was cancelled or already sent, so it can't be changed.
ui.teamBridge.schedule.edit_gone.context_note: Desktop Team Bridge, editing an existing scheduled message. It is no longer pending (cancelled, or delivered, possibly from another device), so editing is impossible. The only action is Close; do not suggest retrying.

ui.teamBridge.schedule.edit_gone_title.context_note: Dialog title replacing 'Schedule message' when the edited scheduled message was cancelled or already sent and can no longer be changed.

ui.teamBridge.schedule.conflict_body_rep.value: Your text was replaced by the version from the other device.
ui.teamBridge.schedule.conflict_body_rep.context_note: Desktop Team Bridge, editing an existing scheduled message that the same person also changed on another device while this dialog was open. The person had edited the text, but the other device's text won and is now shown in the field. Pairs with the 'Use my text instead' button.

ui.teamBridge.schedule.conflict_body_cha.value: The text was changed on the other device.
ui.teamBridge.schedule.conflict_body_cha.context_note: Desktop Team Bridge, editing an existing scheduled message that the same person also changed on another device while this dialog was open. The person had not edited the text; the other device changed it and the new text is shown.

ui.teamBridge.schedule.conflict_time_rep.value: Your new time was replaced by the time set on the other device.
ui.teamBridge.schedule.conflict_time_rep.context_note: Desktop Team Bridge, editing an existing scheduled message that the same person also changed on another device while this dialog was open. The person had picked a new send time, but the other device's time won and is now shown.

ui.teamBridge.schedule.conflict_time_cha.value: The send time was changed on the other device.
ui.teamBridge.schedule.conflict_time_cha.context_note: Desktop Team Bridge, editing an existing scheduled message that the same person also changed on another device while this dialog was open. The person had not changed the send time; the other device changed it.

ui.teamBridge.schedule.conflict_images_a.value: {count, plural, one {An image was added on the other device.} other {# images were added on the other device.}}
ui.teamBridge.schedule.conflict_images_a.context_note: Desktop Team Bridge, editing an existing scheduled message that the same person also changed on another device while this dialog was open. Images attached on the other device now appear in the dialog. ICU plural on count.

ui.teamBridge.schedule.conflict_images_r.value: {count, plural, one {An image was removed on the other device.} other {# images were removed on the other device.}}
ui.teamBridge.schedule.conflict_images_r.context_note: Desktop Team Bridge, editing an existing scheduled message that the same person also changed on another device while this dialog was open. Images the person could still see were removed on the other device. ICU plural on count.

ui.teamBridge.schedule.conflict_review.value: The latest version is shown, with the rest of your changes kept. Review it and try again.
ui.teamBridge.schedule.conflict_review.context_note: Desktop Team Bridge, editing an existing scheduled message that the same person also changed on another device while this dialog was open. Shown when some of the person's own changes survived and the Review button is enabled.

ui.teamBridge.schedule.conflict_nothing_.value: The latest version is shown. None of your changes are left to save.
ui.teamBridge.schedule.conflict_nothing_.context_note: Desktop Team Bridge, editing an existing scheduled message that the same person also changed on another device while this dialog was open. Shown when none of the person's changes remain; the only action offered is Close.

ui.teamBridge.schedule.conflict_restore_.context_note: Desktop Team Bridge, editing an existing scheduled message that the same person also changed on another device while this dialog was open. Button that puts the person's own lost text back into the message field. First person ('my') is the person's own voice.
